alerts.title: Set up alert
alerts.enabledHelp: Starts with future discoveries. Existing listings do not trigger an alert.
alerts.desktopHelp: Every digest also stays in the app's notification history.
alerts.discoveryHelp: A property must match when the app first discovers it. Missing area or analysis can prevent a match. Later changes do not trigger a new-listing alert. Alerts do not download reports or start AI analysis.
alerts.lifecycleHelp: Alerts run while the app is running. After reopening and syncing, missed digests are combined into one catch-up digest per search.
alerts.disabledSources: This search includes sources disabled in Settings: {{sources}}. Alerts only use enabled sources.
alerts.outsideRegions: This search is outside the federal states selected for sync. Change the sync settings to load matching listings.
alerts.loadFailed: The alert could not be loaded.
alerts.saveFailed: The alert could not be saved.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: New listings found for your saved searches, kept with their original results.
notifications.markFailed: The read status could not be saved.
notifications.emptyHelp: Set up an alert on a saved search. Matching properties discovered afterward will appear here.
notifications.noUnreadHelp: New digests will appear here when an alert finds matching listings.
notifications.partialCoverage: Some source data is incomplete. This digest may be missing matches.

attempt.failed: The desktop notification could not be shown. This digest remains available here.
attempt.unsupported: Desktop notifications are unavailable on this system.

delivery.title: Desktop delivery
delivery.help: The operating system controls whether notifications appear. In-app digests remain available regardless of desktop delivery.
delivery.unknown: No desktop notification has been attempted yet.
delivery.attempted: A desktop notification was requested. This does not confirm that it appeared or was read.
delivery.failed: The last desktop notification attempt failed.
delivery.unsupported: Desktop notifications are unavailable on this system.
delivery.settingsHelp: Check the notification permissions for Edikte in your operating system settings.
delivery.loadFailed: Desktop delivery status could not be checked.

desktop.testBody: This is a test notification. Listing digests also remain in the app.
